# A fallback is another agent, not a list of models

When a main agent's provider is unavailable or out of quota, the agents listed in its `fallbacks` take over, in order. The word follows the sources: `fallbacks?` (9/9) over `backups?` (7/9) and `failover` (3/9). Five of the nine document fallback models (`fallback models?`: Claude Agent SDK, Claude Code, Cloudflare Agents, Mastra, Vercel AI SDK), always as a list of models on one agent; the other four document none. Ours runs on another provider with instructions written for its own model, and Claude Code's chain never switches for the case we need: "Authentication, billing, rate-limit, request-size, and transport errors ... never trigger a switch" ([Claude Code](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/model-config#fallback-model-chains)).
